channel.description: The Night Final: the week’s Batman news. Every Sunday, late.

item.title: No. 1 · Clayface's final trailer still belongs to the actor
item.description: Dates came in all week. One face did not move off the front. Read that one first.
item.content:encoded:
Dates came in all week. One face did not move off the front. Read that one first.

In this issue

  1. Screen: Clayface's final trailer still belongs to the actor
  2. Comics: Williamson names Batman: Justice Year for 2027
  3. Screen: Dick Grayson and Jason Todd have their voices, TheWrap says
  4. Comics: Absolute Batman is off the December list, Comic Book Club says
  5. Books: Neal Adams's Batman has an Absolute Edition out
  6. Toys: Hot Toys dates Absolute Batman, and only for Japan
  7. Other: Late wires

item.title: No. 0 · Somebody has to stay up with Batman, and we will
item.description: Sunday before the wire starts. No listing moved, and the paper still owes you a first night: who we are, who this is for, and the map next door.
item.content:encoded:
Sunday before the wire starts. No listing moved, and the paper still owes you a first night: who we are, who this is for, and the map next door.
